major_issues.title: Inferential claims are not aligned with the declared hypothesis families
major_issues.evidence: Holm adjustment covers three eight-test families of cell edges/cell-level backbone differences, but the abstract and discussion promote factorial main effects, interactions and backbone-by-effect modifiers using unadjusted percentile bootstrap intervals. The deterministic, author-constructed 180-item corpus has no stated probability-sampling population. The common-target/cluster reanalysis was created after Round-1 review, so the term registered requires a dated provenance qualification.
major_issues.required_action: Define finite-set and any superpopulation estimands; distinguish composition sensitivity from confidence inference; timestamp the analysis freeze; include core execution factorial effects/modifiers in an explicit cluster-valid multiplicity family or label them exploratory; align abstract and discussion language.
major_issues.verification: Every promoted inferential claim maps to a named family or simultaneous interval, and the manuscript states the exact population/exchangeability assumptions and freeze timing.

major_issues.title: Applied validation and competitive evidence remain below the journal bar
major_issues.evidence: Canonical accuracy uses one exposed synthetic 8-table/98-row database. External grid pairs are automatic and unadjudicated. BIRD is DRAFT_NOT_FROZEN, blocked at 499/500 gold preflight, and has zero model calls. No same-environment direct/decomposition/schema-selection/repair baseline result exists.
major_issues.required_action: Complete a prospectively frozen no-drop public comparison after a uniform Q701 evaluator resolution and add independently reviewed grid-domain evidence, preferably a genuinely new sealed set; otherwise further narrow and justify the article as exploratory.
major_issues.verification: A public baseline ledger and a human-reviewed grid ledger pass independent audits and are incorporated without overclaiming DKASQL reproduction or operational generalization.

major_issues.title: Primary-result reproducibility is externally blocked
major_issues.evidence: GridDB redistribution permission and a permanent artifact DOI/URL are unresolved. An external reviewer cannot obtain the primary database/question records and re-execute all results. Author/declaration placeholders remain. Local hashes establish integrity but not access.
major_issues.required_action: Complete license review and a permanent legal artifact deposit with database/reconstruction generator, prompts, predictions, evaluator, analysis, environment lock, manifests and clean-build instructions; complete all author-approved declarations.
major_issues.verification: A clean environment can fetch the DOI archive, verify hashes, reproduce 1440 outcomes/statistics/figures/PDF, and no W10_FRONT_MATTER marker remains.

minor_issues.title: Dependence-cluster definition and sensitivity need reporting
minor_issues.evidence: The normalization is lowercasing plus quoted/numeric literal replacement and whitespace collapse. There are 70 clusters, 58 singletons, and 12 multi-item clusters containing 122 questions. A reviewer 39-family sensitivity preserved core directions, but those families are difficulty-by-feature groups rather than true authoring templates and are absent from v2.
minor_issues.required_action: Publish the mapping/rationale and add a coarser dependence sensitivity using the best available authoring provenance; describe limitations if true families are unavailable.

minor_issues.title: Common-target outcome should be labeled a direct manipulation check
minor_issues.evidence: The same answer_shape.column_count provenance supplies the hint target and the projected-column score; it does not independently assess semantic benefit.
minor_issues.required_action: Disclose shared provenance and freeze timing, report the 61/31/57/31 target distribution for 1/2/3/4 columns, and call the endpoint an adherence/manipulation diagnostic.

minor_issues.title: Statistical details and primary citations are incomplete
minor_issues.evidence: The paper lacks citations for cluster bootstrap, randomization/sign-flip inference, Holm and McNemar and omits the exact weighting, SQL normalization, Monte Carlo correction and seed details available in code.
minor_issues.required_action: Add primary citations and sufficient algorithmic detail to reproduce the analysis from the article and supplement.

minor_issues.title: Data-resource table has nonnumeric GridDB table/row entries
minor_issues.evidence: Table 1 reports maintenance schema/local under headers Tables/Rows.
minor_issues.required_action: Replace with 8/98 and move provenance/evidence status to a separate column.

minor_issues.title: Rebuild checks do not enforce immutable upstream inputs
minor_issues.evidence: The v2 generator records current upstream hashes instead of refusing unexpected hashes; tests validate current outputs but not live upstream files against a separately frozen contract. The generator self-writes VISUAL_QA pass, no dependency lock is provided, and README still names canonical_dual_backbone.
minor_issues.required_action: Add a pre-existing input hash contract, live hash test, dependency/runtime lock, clean rebuild command, separately signed manual QA, and updated README.

minor_issues.title: Execution equality terminology is inconsistent
minor_issues.evidence: Section 3.6 says strict execution correctness despite acknowledged accidental equivalence on one database state.
minor_issues.required_action: Use strict execution equality on the frozen database state throughout and reserve correctness for semantic/test-suite evidence.

minor_issues.title: Round-1 response is stale relative to the revised paper
minor_issues.evidence: The response says the manuscript has not yet been edited, lists intended rather than actual locations, contains encoding corruption, and predates the current BIRD blocker wording.
minor_issues.required_action: Synchronize the response with the submitted TeX/PDF and preserve baseline/human/license/DOI/metadata items as open.

submission_blockers: corrected inferential hierarchy and multiplicity treatment
executed public comparison and independently reviewed grid-domain validation or further major narrowing
GridDB license decision and permanent public reproducibility archive
